PLAN "Upper Body Strength for Climber with Shoulder Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper body strength in pain-free range"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Mobility" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest_supported_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_external_rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_pushup (hands elevated) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_facepull (to chest, elbows below shoulder) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body Strength B":
        warmup:
          airbike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown (to chest, wide grip, stop at chin) 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_bench_press (neutral grip, 30 deg incline, pain-free ROM) 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row (neutral grip) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          band_pull_apart 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          upper_trap_stretch 2m
